title: Kissed Silky Chinese Christmas Pudding Baozi
description: A tangy and silky Chinese dish featuring Christmas pudding, made with a soffritto base and wrapped in a paleo-friendly baozi form.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery, and cook until they are softened.
Add the crumbled Christmas pudding to the pan and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour, eggs, and coconut milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it cool.
Divide the mixture into 8 equal portions and wrap each portion in a paleo-friendly baozi wrapper.
Serve the baozi warm or at room temperature.
